title: Observability Weekly Notes - 2026-05-11
content:
Weekly observability notes (2026-05-11)

Summary:
- Focus this week: tracing sampling rollout, dashboard refresh for cost telemetry, and reducing time-to-insight in the metrics pipeline.
- Small incident on 2026-05-09 (high DB read latency affecting metrics ingest) was mitigated; root cause related to a bad Prometheus query in the ingest job.
- Cost telemetry panels prototyped; initial token-cost per-model view is ready for alpha testing.

Standups (high-level):
- Mon 2026-05-11
  - Asha: finished head-based sampling prototype for Jaeger; started integration tests with service A.
  - Marcus: migrated infra-overview panels to new grafana datasource; fixed panel layout for GPU cost chart.
  - Sofia: investigating metrics pipeline lag spikes; re-ran ETL jobs to validate retention policy.
  - Ethan: added TTL pruning to trace storage test cluster; collecting size/latency metrics.

- Tue 2026-05-12
  - Asha: rollout plan drafted for sampling change (canary 10%->50% over 48h). Open question on downstream billing accuracy with sampled spans.
  - Marcus: dashboard perf improved by optimizing queries; reduced panel load time 35% on infra-overview.
  - Sofia: identified slow PromQL expression in ingest job (linked JIRA).
  - Ethan: discovered trace-join inefficiency when correlating spans with request_id; filed PR to address join algorithm.

Progress / Highlights:
- Tracing:
  - Head-based sampling prototype complete; unit and integration tests passing.
  - Canary rollout plan: start with internal-only traffic, increase to 50% over 48h, monitor span coverage metrics and error budgets.
  - Work to add model_id and customer_tier tags on root spans to enable per-customer cost attribution is in PR (GH #212).
  - Action: Asha to run end-to-end cost attribution test by 2026-05-15.

- Dashboards:
  - Infra-overview Grafana board migrated to new datasource; panels now use downstream-aggregated metrics to reduce query cost.
  - New cost-telemetry board: GPU token cost by model (daily/7d/30d), per-customer token usage, cache-hit saving estimate panel. Prototype link in artifacts.
  - Marcus optimized queries: replaced expensive label_join operations with pre-aggregated metrics in metrics-agg job.

- Cost telemetry:
  - Billing export alignment: fixed mapping issue where some model variants were grouped under legacy model tags; updated mapping table and reprocessed last 7 days.
  - Per-customer tagging on spans is now available in test env; will enable export pipeline to populate billing_cost table.
  - Need to confirm rounding rules for cost attribution (finance asked for 'per-token millisecond weighting' vs 'per-request flat share').

Incidents / Alerts:
- 2026-05-09: Metrics ingest lag (P1->P2 after mitigation)\  - Symptom: ingest worker queue backlog, delayed metrics by ~7-12 minutes.
  - Mitigation: scaled ingest workers, rolled back a recent PromQL change in the ETL.
  - Root cause: inefficient regex/label processing in ETL (JIRA-OBS-478).
  - Follow-up: rewrite problematic query and add unit tests for ETL transforms (owner: Sofia, due 2026-05-14).

SLOs & Signals:
- Tracing coverage target: aim for 95% root-span coverage for production traffic (currently ~92% before sampling change).
- Dashboard availability: target 99.5% Uptime for critical infra dashboards.
- Cost telemetry accuracy: prototype accuracy within 3% of raw billing export for initial customers.

Risks & Blockers:
- Sampling rollout may reduce granularity needed for rare-failure debugging; mitigation: preserve full traces for error-tagged requests and increase debug retention window.
- Metrics pipeline CPU spikes persist under heavy scrapes; need to investigate Prometheus scrape intervals and cardinality.
- Billing/finance decision pending on cost split model; blocks final design of cost attribution dashboards.

Next week plan (2026-05-18):
- Complete canary sampling rollout (Asha) and validate tracing SLOs.
- Finalize cost-telemetry dashboard and run alpha with customer-success internal team (Marcus + Priya).
- Rewrite ETL transform tests and land patch to prevent future regressions (Sofia).
- Optimize trace-join algorithm and land GH #215 (Ethan).

Action items (owners):
- Asha: run end-to-end cost attribution test and provide results to finance by 2026-05-15.
- Marcus: finish dashboard alpha tweaks and add dashboard-level automations for snapshotting costs by day (due 2026-05-17).
- Sofia: land ETL fix for JIRA-OBS-478 and add regression tests (due 2026-05-14).
- Ethan: merge trace-join optimization PR and validate under load (due 2026-05-16).
- Priya: coordinate customer-success alpha for cost dashboard and collect feedback (due 2026-05-20).

Notes & Open Questions:
- Finance: need final sign-off on per-token vs per-request weighting; follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-05-13.
- Should we keep debug retention extension for sampling canary longer than 7 days? Proposal: 14 days for canary period. Feedback from SRE required.
- Consider adding a lightweight attribution key in API proxy to reduce reliance on expensive span-joins.

References / Links:
- Tracing roadmap: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Tracing+Roadmap
- Grafana board (infra-overview): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/infra-overview
- GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/212
- JIRA: JIRA-OBS-482, JIRA-OBS-478
